note: The roster (S15, S15b; docs/art-style-guide.md, "Characters"). Each character: id, name, sheet (assets/<sheet>.png + .json), and optional: short (for the score panel's 62 px name slot and the result, when name doesn't fit), skin and hair recolours as [from, to] palette colours (skin everywhere, hair only on the head), kit as [from, to] palette colours (the P2 / CPU kit, in place of the standard swap). The game reads the order as listed; P1 starts on the first, P2 on the second.
